text_block_list.text: It's the day before the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Phew.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Yeah. My legs feel nice and light.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Seems like the regimen Trainer's put
together is
doing me good. Probably.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(I could do without all the damn
nagging,
though.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
All right, all that's left is a quick
cooldown and...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Scratch that. I think I'm overdue for a
visit to my
favorite spot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(This place is always so peaceful... It
never fails to
calm me down.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Maybe 'cause no one's here. All people
ever do
is make fun of me.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Short, spineless, and weak they'd say.
Not a
single redeeming feature. Like I
was practically
wearing a sign telling
people to bully me.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(It doesn't even matter if I'm on the turf
or not.
No one lets me just live my life.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Enough about that. They can go ahead
and say
whatever they want.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(I'll make them eat their words once they
see what
I'm capable of.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I should head home and take a break. I'll
need the
rest so I can win tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (No... I will win. I have to.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(The only way I can get people to
respect me is
through racing!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me...

A voice suddenly calls out to Narita
Taishin, and
she spins around in surprise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're Нарита Таисин, right? The one
running in
all those races...
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
A redheaded girl, as small as Narita
Taishin,
stands before her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yeah, what of it?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The G1 race tomorrow... What's it called
again?
The Satsuki Sho? You're running
in it, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
You're still doing it even though the top
two are
going to be there. And they're
stronger and have
better physiques.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text: Excuse you? What are you getting at?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Nothing. I'm just stating the obvious.
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on! No one's rooting for
you! No
one thinks you can win!
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make you want to give up?
Most
people would...
text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl

text_block_list.text: Not really?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
No one's ever expected me to win. Not
even
once.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I just want to make everyone regret how
they've
treated me. Everyone else has a
"dream" or
whatever, but me? Mine's
practically revenge.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But who cares? Even if I'm being driven
by petty
revenge, why should I give up
on my goal?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to see this through. I'm going
to show
them what I can do. That's it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The red-haired girl bites her lip, glares
at Narita
Taishin, and runs off. Her legs
are wrapped tightly
in braces meant for
sports.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm going to win. I have to.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин's fighting spirit is burning
fiercely.
She's ready.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Here I go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ticket! Let's see that amazing final dash
of yours
today!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Бива Хаяхидэ! I came to see you wiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Can you hear that, folks? Just the sight
of them is
making the crowd go wild!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
This is it. Everyone at the Satsuki Sho
has their
eyes on the showdown between
the top two,
Уиннинг Тикит and Biwa
Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Listen to those idiots making a huge fuss
over
nothing...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Well, I'll show them all what I'm made of!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Are you feeling it too, Ticket?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm all jittery and tingly!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
They call us the top two, but we know
better than
anyone that that's not
accurate.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Taishin! I'm not gonna lose! I'm gonna
give it all
I've got!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: And thus begins the Satsuki Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
